title: Learning Kalman Policy for Singular Unknown Covariances via Riemannian Regularization
summary: Kalman filtering is a cornerstone of estimation theory, yet learning the optimal filter under unknown and potentially singular noise covariances remains a fundamental challenge. In this paper, we revisit this problem through the lens of control--estimation duality and data-driven policy optimization, formulating the learning of the steady-state Kalman gain as a stochastic policy optimization problem directly from measurement data.
